entities.name: Lammasu
entities.description: Species with the body of a bull, a bird's wings and a horned human head.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where lammasu once ruled the velds.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Plane whose lammasu are enigmatic nomads.

events.summary: Ravnican lammasu once ruled the velds before the urban sprawl; few remain, hunted by horrors.
events.quote: Ravnican lammasu once ruled the velds of the plane before the arrival of the urban sprawl.

events.summary: Tarkir lammasu arrive frequently at turning points of history.
events.quote: but they arrive frequently at turning points of history.
